title: Reservoir NFT API group reaches announced retirement date
summary: Contemporaneous reporting quoted Reservoir's announcement that NFT trading infrastructure and developer API services would terminate October 15, 2025. The operator's reported migration options included 0xSequence and Alchemy; the remaining Relay product is outside the retired API group.
replacement: 0xSequence or Alchemy alternatives reportedly coordinated for migration
migration_path: Review integration dependencies, export needed NFT metadata/ordering data where available, and migrate to a qualified alternative with endpoint-by-endpoint coverage validation.
user_impact: Historical Reservoir NFT API integrations were expected to lose hosted services after the announced October 15, 2025 deadline; actual state of every individual endpoint has not been probed.
notes: The event records the announced effective retirement date, NOT an authenticated endpoint test. Published legacy docs remain accessible.
